context: A teacher and a uni intern plan an official school exhibition
purpose: Teach: 稼い/及ば/導く/禁じ/新着/実在/事典/オフィシャル

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 来月のオフィシャルな校内展示会、テーマをそろそろ固めたいの。
lines.en: I want to lock down the theme for next month's official school exhibition soon.
lines.style: Calm professional tone, gentle but firm leadership voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新着の資料を見ていたんですが、実在の地域作家を取り上げるのはどうでしょう。
lines.en: Yes. I was looking at the newly arrived materials—how about featuring real local authors?
lines.style: Polite intern register, slightly nervous but eager to contribute ideas.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいわね。生徒を地域文化への関心へと導く企画になるわ。
lines.en: That's good. It would guide the students toward an interest in local culture.
lines.style: Warm encouraging tone, teacher praising a promising suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 図書室の郷土事典から人物を選べば、裏取りも楽だと思います。
lines.en: If we pick figures from the library's regional encyclopedia, fact-checking should be easy.
lines.style: Practical research-minded tone, thinking aloud about logistics.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ただし著作権の関係で、写真の無断使用は禁じられているから注意してね。
lines.en: However, due to copyright, unauthorized use of photos is prohibited, so be careful.
lines.style: Cautionary instructive tone, reminding intern of legal boundaries.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。あと、卒業生で執筆業で稼いでいる方にも声をかけてみますか。
lines.en: Understood. Also, should I reach out to alumni who make a living writing?
lines.style: Proactive suggestion, slightly hesitant checking permission first.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひお願い。私一人の人脈じゃ及ばないところがあるから助かるわ。
lines.en: Please do. My personal network alone falls short, so that would really help me.
lines.style: Humble grateful tone, acknowledging the intern's value openly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: では今週中に企画書をまとめて、先生にお見せしますね。
lines.en: Then I'll put together a proposal by the end of this week and show you.
lines.style: Confident closing commitment, polite junior wrapping up the meeting.
